input: Same public encoded global context, previous factored action/event-wait result, actual previous elapsed ticks and public events as singleGRU. Historical frames are learned projections of those public inputs.
memory: Concatenate oldest to newest; zero padding at episode start. Finite raw projected history, no hidden recurrent state, no GRU/LSTM modules or auxiliary heads. Common gru_width means actor/critic output width; gru_layers is unused in this finite-history candidate.
gradient: Prepend up toK-1 relevant frames for every PPO core. Re-encode all of them under current parameters with gradients; no detached old-parameter cache. Leading-frame PPO losses excluded; no need to rebuild earlier episode prefix.
time: K is decisions, not ticks. Real action durations can be0 and interruptible wait duration varies. Report actual tick horizon separately; do not call it a fixed temporal memory span.
reference: experiments/t7/dual_timescale_v1/single_seed0..2.json; architecture13, headless singleGRU256x2. Width selection remains incomplete; implementation prepared without making memory winner claims.
comparisons: All three initializations, same frozen interaction nodes and tasks, actual costs/parameter counts; no hours-long adoption gate before short actual smoke.
auxiliary_prediction: Cancelled, no replacement heads or losses.
